column3: shed_antler|cube|A shed deer antler's bone as a tile for small boxes: light brown ridged antler bone (#6e5c40 #8a7656 #a8946e #c4b08a) with short dark grooves running lengthwise, left to right, and patches of bone-pale (#e0d6bc #ece4d0) where it is worn smooth; no pink or red; seamless
column4: chest_inside|built|The inside of a wooden chest: four horizontal dark oak boards (#2e2720 #3e3328 #4d4035 #5a4b3c), a step darker and plainer than oak planks, in shadow, with thin dark gaps between the boards and a few nail heads (#2a2a2e); no metal bands
